thread:
andrew: Heads up — since 02:10 UTC eu-south controller-manager has been OOM/restarting in a ~2m loop. Leader election flips, and GPU pod volume attach is failing so Dedicated pools are thrashing.

andrew: logs snippet:```controller-manager[pid=3284]: E0304 02:10:12.123456 3284 leaderelection.go:286] failed to transition: failed to acquire lease: timed out
controller-manager[pid=3284]: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
controller-manager[pid=3284]: goroutine 47 [running]:
...
```

meera: omg, saw alerts too. apiserver p50 lat spiked ~600ms around same time? @andrew can you paste node list for affected gpu nodes? :eyes:

andrew: `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia -o wide` ->
```
gpu-eu3-12   Ready  32d  v1.26.1   10.240.3.12   eu-south
gpu-eu3-15   Ready  2d   v1.25.8   10.240.3.15   eu-south
```

jordan: ah — gpu-eu3-12 shows kubelet v1.26.1 while others still 1.25.x. Did a node image auto-upgrade go out?

lee: we had a kubelet package rollback scheduled but one host updated early. I think the kubelet default cgroup driver changed on that build (systemd->cgroupfs) so kubelet restarted and kubelet <-> controller-manager watch reconnects flooded leader election.

meera: that could explain leader flips. When kubelets bounce they briefly lose leases and controller-manager sees quorum changes. That + a small leaseDuration will flip leader repeatedly.

andrew: repro steps: on a node, restart kubelet -> within 30s controller-manager increments leader-change counter and a new leader vote begins. AttachVolume calls for pods on that node hang during kubelet reconnection -> scheduler reschedules to other pools -> Dedicated autoscaler spins up extra GPUs. Cost spike starting 02:15 UTC.

jordan: quick checks run: `kubectl describe pod <stuck-gpu-pod>` shows `AttachVolume timed out waiting for the attach operation` and `NodeAffinity` events.

lee: proposed short-term mitigation: cordon gpu-eu3-12, drain, rollback kubelet to 1.25.8 image, restart kubelet. Also bump controller-manager leaderElection leaseDuration to 45s in controlplane config to tolerate short bounces.

meera: agree. I'll cordon+drain right now. @andrew can you open an incident and track cost blowout? :rotating_light:

andrew: opening INC-8421 with notes and Grafana links. Pulling recent controlplane logs and autoscaler events.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started: kubelet-rollback/gpu-nodes/v1 -> 1 node targeted (gpu-eu3-12).

jordan: after draining, attach errors stopped within one reconciliation cycle. Controller-manager leader remained stable for ~6m post-rollback.

meera: action items: 1) roll back node image -> done for gpu-eu3-12; 2) schedule controlled rollout of kubelet image across eu-south with cgroup-driver check; 3) PR to increase leaderElection lease/renewDeadline in prod controlplane (meera + lee); 4) postmortem to quantify cost delta from autoscaler spin (andrew).

lee: I'll draft the PR for leaderElection and add a feature flag to allow shorter leases for low-latency regions only after we have coordinated kubelet upgrades.

andrew: thanks team. tagging oncall followup for long-term: verify upgrade pipeline doesn't silently change kubelet cgroup driver (CI gate), and add a preflight `kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath` check in the node image rollout job.

meera: noted — filing tasks in INC-8421 and ENGOPS-401. closing slack thread, will update incident doc when postmortem written. :white_check_mark:
